'''Farns Monsbee''' was a [[human]] who flew as a [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. For a [[time]] he was the lone [[pilot]] stationed at a [[Cassidode VI rebel outpost|rebel base]] on [[Cassidode VI]], before transferring to join [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]] under [[General]] [[Antoc Merrick]] at the [[Great Temple|rebel headquarters]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. In [[1 BBY]], he participated in a [[Mission to Eadu|mission]] to [[Death|kill]] Imperial [[scientist]] [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso]] on the [[planet]] [[Eadu]]. The [[squadron]] was later scrambled as part of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] to [[Battle of Scarif|aid]] [[Rogue One|rebel forces]] on the planet [[Scarif]] in [[Thief|stealing]] the [[Death Star plans|plans]] to the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]]. During the battle, Monsbee flew as [[Blue Five]] in a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]].

Monsbee, along with the rest of Blue Squadron, was ordered to aid the rebels on the surface of Scarif, but only thirteen [[Starfighter|vessels]] from the squadron made it through the Imperial [[Shield Gate]] above the planet before the gate closed. The split squadron then [[Starfighter combat|fought]] against the Empire on both sides of the gate and suffered several casualties, but the [[Data-tape|plans]] were finally transmitted to the [[fleet]], and the surviving Blue Squadron pilots retreated back to Yavin.

==Biography==
===Engagement at Eadu===
{{Quote|Squadron up. Target Eadu.|General Davits Draven orders Farns Monsbee and Blue Squadron to Eadu|audio=SquadronUp.flac|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
Farns Monsbee was a [[human]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] as a [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. For a period of his service, he was the sole [[Snub-fighter|snubfighter]] [[pilot]] stationed at an ill-equipped [[Cassidode VI rebel outpost|rebel outpost]] on [[Cassidode VI]], where he logged a large number of flying [[Standard hour|hours]]<ref name="UVG" /> in the base's sole [[starfighter]], an [[X-wing starfighter|X-wing]].<ref name="HC75">{{HelmetCollectionCite|75|Databank A-Z}}</ref> Monsbee was eventually transferred to [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]], an unusually large starfighter [[squadron]] within the [[Massassi Group]] of rebels operating out of the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. While on the moon, he often served as a [[Scout|recon flier]].<ref name="UVG" />

[[File:Mission_to_Eadu_X_Wings_cropped.png|thumb|left|300px|Farns Monsbee flew with Blue Squadron at Eadu on a mission to kill Imperial scientist Galen Erso.]]
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', which includes the [[mission to Eadu]] and the [[Battle of Scarif]], to [[1 BBY]].</ref> Blue Squadron was under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[General]] [[Antoc Merrick]]. After the Alliance lost contact with [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service|Intelligence]] [[Intelligence officer|officer]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], who had been sent to [[Mission to Eadu|kill]] the Imperial [[scientist]] [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso]] on the [[planet]] [[Eadu]], Blue Squadron was<ref name="Rogue One" /> partially raised<ref name="Partial">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' states that the [[Battle of Scarif]] is the first instance of the entirety of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]] being mobilized. This means the [[squadron]] must have been only partially mobilized during the earlier [[mission to Eadu]].</ref> by General [[Davits Draven]] to complete the [[Operation Fracture|mission]].<ref name="Rogue One" /> Monsbee numbered among the pilots who participated in the mission<ref name="Topps">{{SWCT|set=2020 Base Series|cardname=Farns Monsbee}}</ref> and flew through the stone pillars of Eadu before opening fire on the landing platform of the secret [[Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory|Imperial laboratory]] where Erso was stationed.<ref name="Rogue One" />

The attack landed a successful blow that led to Erso's [[death]], after which Blue Squadron briefly engaged enemy [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s and [[turret]]s before retreating. Monsbee and the rest of the squadron then returned with Andor and his team to Yavin, where a meeting of the [[Alliance Civil Government]] convened to discuss a potential attack on the [[Imperial Center of Military Research|Imperial base]] on the planet [[Scarif]] to [[Thief|steal]] the [[Death Star plans|plans]] for the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]]. However, the council ultimately decided that there would be no attack.<ref name="Rogue One" />

===Scramble for Scarif===
{{Quote|Blue Squadron, on me.|General Antoc Merrick orders Farns Monsbee and Blue Squadron to follow him through the Shield Gate|audio=Merrick-OnMe.flac|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
Despite the council's decision, the recently enlisted rebel [[Jyn Erso]] led a [[Rogue One|squad]] of Alliance operatives to Scarif to capture the [[Death Star]] [[Data-tape|plans]] by themselves. Soon thereafter,<ref name="Rogue One" /> the entirety of Blue Squadron<ref name="UVG" /> numbered among the [[Alliance Military|forces]] that Alliance [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]] scrambled to aid the rebels on Scarif.<ref name="Rogue One" /> Monsbee flew to the [[Battle of Scarif|battle]] as [[Blue Five]] in a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]]<ref name="UVG" /> with an [[astromech droid]] bearing [[Color|orange]] and silver plating.<ref name="Rogue One" />

[[File:FarnsMonsbeeQuote.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Farns Monsbee during the Battle of Scarif]]
Upon the reinforcements' arrival in [[Realspace|space]] above Scarif, Raddus ordered Blue Squadron to quickly head to the planet's surface through the Imperial [[Shield Gate]]—the only opening in the otherwise impenetrable [[planetary shield]] over Scarif—so that it could aid Erso's [[squad]]. As Merrick ordered his pilots to follow him in, Monsbee made an observation that they would not have long before the Imperials closed the gate, thereby sealing the planet.<ref name="Rogue One" />

Monsbee proved to be correct, as only twelve of the squadron's X-wing starfighters and a single [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]] made it through before the gate closed, with three Blue Squadron pilots dying as their X-wings impacted with the gate. At least three of Blue Squadron's X-wing pilots managed to pull up in [[time]] and retreat from the gate to aid the rest of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] remaining in [[orbit]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

===Battle of Scarif and aftermath===
Those Blue Squadron pilots who did make it through the gate provided aerial support to the ground forces on Scarif, although ultimately all perished.<ref name="HC71">{{HelmetCollectionCite|71|Weapons & Uniforms}}</ref> Erso eventually succeeded in transmitting the Death Star plans to the [[fleet]] after the Shield Gate was destroyed, but she and the rest of the forces on Scarif's surface were killed when the Death Star arrived and fired on the Imperial base.<ref name="Rogue One" />

A portion of Blue Squadron and the rebel fleet escaped and returned to Yavin, but between Eadu and Scarif, Blue and [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadrons]] had lost nineteen pilots and crew. So few pilots were left that the Alliance was unsure if it could even field Blue Squadron when the Death Star [[Battle of Yavin|attacked]] Yavin not long after.<ref name="Duty Roster">{{StoryCite|story=Duty Roster|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref> The Alliance ultimately only fielded Red Squadron, [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]], and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] at the battle.<ref name="Odyssey">''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Monsbee_Helmet.png|thumb|right|250px|Farns Monsbee's helmet]]
Farns Monsbee was a fine team player<ref name="GalacticFiles">{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=Farns Monsbee|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/170092/cid/11644227/2018-Topps-Star-Wars:-Galactic-Files-RO-34-Farns-Monsbee}}</ref> and worked well within a squadron, and he had far more flying hours logged than his colleagues thanks to his time on Cassidode VI.<ref name="UVG" /> He was a keen [[historian]] and had a reputation for being chatty in the recreation room, a habit caused by his time in isolation on Cassidode VI.<ref name="HC71">{{HelmetCollectionCite|71|Weapons & Uniforms}}</ref> Monsbee had light skin, blue [[eye]]s, and blond [[hair]].<ref name="UVG" />

==Skills and abilities==
Farns Monsbee had above average intelligence and average speed and diplomatic ability. His strength and fighting abilities were slightly below average and he was not [[Force-sensitive]].<ref name="GalacticFiles" />

==Equipment==
As a pilot of the Rebellion, Farns Monsbee was equipped with a blue [[flight suit]], a white [[flight harness]], a gray [[Diagnostech life support unit]], and a dark-green [[K-22995 light flight helmet]]. The [[Flight helmet|latter]] was adorned with a modified version of the [[Starbird (symbol)|Wren Phoenix crest]].<ref name="UVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It's quite a weird job, but it was good, it was great. I got to sit in an X-Wing and fly around. Well, not fly around, you get put on a gimble ''[sic]'', and there's a big screen around you, so it was like being in a fairground ride, a very expensive fairground ride.|Simon Farnaby describes filming as Farns Monsbee|<ref name="Interview">{{WebCite|url=https://www.denofgeek.com/movies/simon-farnaby-interview-paddington-2-yonderland-star-wars|text=Simon Farnaby interview: Paddington 2, Yonderland, Star Wars|author=Mortimer, Ben|date=2017-11-07|work=[[Wikipedia:Den of Geek|''Den of Geek'']]|archivedate=20200913144715}}</ref>}}
[[File:SimonFarnaby.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Simon Farnaby, who portrayed Farns Monsbee in ''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'']]
Farns Monsbee was portrayed by [[Simon Farnaby]] in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''. The character was not identified in the film<ref name="Rogue One" /> but received the name "Farns Monsbee"—a [[tuckerization]] of Farnaby's name—in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released alongside the film.<ref name="UVG" /> An X-wing carrying an astromech droid with the same orange coloring as Monsbee's droid can be seen among the fighters defending the Alliance Fleet once the Shield Gate has shut, although it is unclear if this is the same droid and therefore Monsbee's ship or not.<ref name="Rogue One" />

Farnaby initially turned down the role of Blue Five after being offered it over the phone by a producer, as he was in the middle of writing the film [[Wikipedia:Paddington 2|''Paddington 2'']]. However, after his writing partner, [[Wikipedia:Paul King (director)|Paul King]], told him to take the role despite their deadline, Farnaby accepted and filmed his X-wing [[cockpit]] scenes on a gimbal with a large screen around him. Farnaby is uncertain why he was chosen for the role but has stated that the makers of ''Rogue One'' were looking for characterful faces.<ref name="Interview" />
